audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and 6 were marked 'Skill' and 2+ items was marked Kled, contradicting the packet chart, the 53.62% win rate and the page's own text, which says Kled out-trades a pre-Rylai Vlad and that Vlad hard-outscales past two items.
audit.why: Kled's whole lane is levels 2-6 and first item; Vladimir's is two-plus items, where Sanguine Pool's untargetability plus AP burst beat Kled's dismounted form.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 and 6 flipped to Kled; 2+ items flipped to Vladimir, in both layers.

audit.why: Kled: W at 2, full E-W-E at 3, R at 6 (140/125/110s), Eclipse. Vladimir: Sanguine Pool rank-ups (28s down to 16s), Rylai, second AP item.
audit.corrected: Spike text kept, Pool's real cooldown added where it makes the advice actionable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sanguine Pool is called a 'long cooldown' throughout without ever giving the number, and nothing says what the pool actually eats.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28/25/22/19/16s and gives 2 seconds of untargetability — it removes the Beartrap yank, the E return strike and the R ram from the fight entirely, and it is 28s at rank 1, the single biggest punish window in the lane. Tides of Blood (E) is blocked by units, so standing behind your minions turns his poke off.
audit.corrected: Real numbers and the unit-block detail written into the cooldown and interaction fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is named in the item line but never tied to a timing, and the trading fields ignore it.
audit.why: Transfusion heals on every cast and Hemoplague heals him per champion hit — without Grievous Wounds applied before the extended trade, Kled's W procs are refunded.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Dodges your burst. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool (W), 28s at rank 1: 2s untargetable, it eats your Q yank, E return and R ram. Bait it, then you have 28 seconds. - Tides of Blood (E) is blocked by units — stand behind a minion. - Your R (140/125/110s): kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Vladimir's Sanguine Pool: Dodges your burst. Bait it. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool (W) is 28s at rank 1 and 2s untargetable — it deletes your Q yank, E return and R ram. Bait it, then Q-yank and unload W. His E is blocked by minions.

edits.before: Dodges your burst. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 28s at rank 1, and 2s untargetable eats your whole combo. Bait it first, always.

edits.before: Beartrap Vladimir when his answer is down, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage and remount mid-fight.
edits.after: Apply Grievous Wounds before the trade, not during — Transfusion and Hemoplague refund your W procs otherwise. Then Beartrap and rip the full mounted combo.

edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two seconds untargetable erases your Q yank, E return and R — bait it before you spend anything.

notes: Chart rows 4-5, 6 and 2+ items disagreed with the packet and with the page's own prose; flipped as matched pairs. The anti-heal interaction (the one missing item for this matchup) is now tied to a timing rather than just an item name.
